High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 438 of code of criminal procedure for grant of anticipatory bail relating to FIR No.01/2004 registered at Police Station-C.I.D Bhopal,
District Bhopal (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 406, 120-B, 477-A, 201, 409 of Indian Penal Code & Section 74, 75(D)(E) of MP Cooperative Society Act.
2 . Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that co-accused persons in the case has been enlarged on anticipatory bail.
It is submitted that case of applicant is also similar to them.
Applicant is also member of the Board.
In these circumstances, applicant may be released on anticipatory bail.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of anticipatory bail and submitted that applicant is member of the Board and he was helping other co-accused persons in committing the fraud.
Case of the applicant is not on parity with other co-accused persons.
Other co-accused persons were women and considering the said fact, their case has been considered by this Court.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
5.

Considering the manner in which, fraud has been committed and amount of money involved in the case and also taking note of the fact that applicant is required for further investigation in the case, anticipatory bail application filed by the applicant is dismissed.
